item.title: Seminarios OfiLibre. Free FPGAs with Obijuan
item.description: Demo FPGAs: Presentation on FPGAs: Juan González, the popular Obijuan, will show us some basic principles of digital electronics, in a practical way, using one of the most advanced platforms: free FPGAs, which are completely changing the world of computing (both hardware and software), as they allow “synthesizing” digital circuits from their description.
